title: They’re back
content: I used to have the mall world dream at least 2x per month since a teenager through my adult life. Thought I was done with the mall worlds, train stations, & the schools with those dirty co-ed bathrooms. It’s been years since I’ve woke up in a cold sweat from these worlds! Welp, a couple of days ago, I was back at the mall! I was once ago running around that damn multi-level mall, trying to find the exit! And as always it’s daytime when I arrive but always night when I leave. Running around the parking lot searching for my car in the darkness while everyone else is able to find their cars and leaving me alone. How can these dreams leave my life then suddenly reappear like they never left? Exact same scenes/ scenarios right down to some of the sales clerks lol. Side note: it’s also ironic that I all of a sudden find this group today. What a strange reality we live in.
